title: Not Quite Love
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Due to family circumstances, high schooler Umi Sayama moves in with the Hiroi family next door. Their son Sho, her childhood crush and eight years her senior, has gone from honor student to a scruffy manga artist who never leaves his sweatpants (Square Enix / Manga UP! blurb). Umi insists her feelings are 'more than a first crush' but 'definitely not love'. Ongoing (about 10 chapters per MU).
life_message: Growing up means seeing the people you idolized as they really are, and finding a bond worth keeping anyway.

content.note: Teen girl's crush on an adult man eight years older living in the same house (blurb; AniList Age Gap; MU Older Male Younger Female; MangaDex suggestive). Whether it becomes romance is to verify.
